subject: Operations
title: Regionalization of Supply Chains
description: Learn Regionalization of Supply Chains in one minute.

hook.text: Instead of one global supply chain, companies now build three: one for the Americas, one for Europe, one for Asia.

buildup.text: Regionalization creates self-contained supply chains within major trade blocs, reducing cross-continental dependency.

discovery.text: Each regional chain sources, makes, and distributes locally—shortening lead times and reducing geopolitical exposure.

twist.text: Regionalization sacrifices some scale economies. Three smaller networks cost more than one optimized global network.

climax.text: Post-COVID, companies like Toyota, Samsung, and Apple are building redundant regional supply chains for resilience.

punchline.text: Three smaller chains may be safer than one giant one.

quiz.question: What does supply chain regionalization sacrifice?
